name: Solve.rs Fiskalizacija
author: solvers

sections.description:
Fiskalizacija WooCommerce porudžbina preko Solve.rs kase. Svaka porudžbina dobija fiskalni račun automatski, broj računa i link za proveru na sajtu Poreske uprave upisuju se u porudžbinu i prikazuju kupcu, a otkazana porudžbina dobija refundaciju.

Selling online in Serbia requires a fiscal receipt for every sale to a consumer. This plugin connects your WooCommerce shop to Solve.rs, an online cash register (ESIR) and business app for Serbian companies, so every order gets a fiscal receipt without manual work.

What it does

  • Sends each order to Solve.rs when it is placed and whenever its status changes (paid, shipped, completed, cancelled, refunded).
  • Solve.rs issues the fiscal receipt when the order reaches the status you choose (when paid, shipped or completed) — automatically or with one click.
  • The receipt number (PFR) and the verification link are saved on the order, shown on the order page and in the customer emails.
  • The PDF of every receipt is downloaded and kept with the order: open it from the order, send it to the customer with one click (“Send the fiscal receipt to the customer”, also in the order actions), attach it to the WooCommerce customer emails, and the customer can download it from the order page.
  • A cancelled or refunded order gets a refund receipt.
  • Cash on delivery is handled correctly: the receipt is issued when the order is shipped or completed, not when it is placed.
  • Optional: orders paid before shipping get an advance receipt, and the final receipt follows when they are shipped.
  • Optional: bank transfer orders get a pro forma invoice with an IPS QR code; the receipt is issued when the payment arrives.
  • Optional: a company tax number (PIB) field at checkout, so companies get a receipt with their tax number.
  • Optional: stock follows the Solve.rs warehouse (shop, cash register and web shop share one stock), with a live stock check before the order is placed.
  • Products are sent to Solve.rs so they can be linked with warehouse products, even when names and SKUs differ.
  • Works with the classic and the block checkout and with WooCommerce order tables (HPOS).

What you need

  • A Solve.rs account with the Web shop module (you can request a 10-day demo account at invoice.solve.rs/zahtev).
  • An https site, so Solve.rs can send receipt numbers and stock back to your shop.

External services

This plugin connects to the Solve.rs service (https://invoice.solve.rs), which issues the fiscal receipts. It is required: without it the plugin does nothing.

  • What is sent and when: when an order is placed or its status changes, the plugin sends the order to Solve.rs: order ID and number, status, payment method, date, currency, total, the customer’s name, email, phone, company, tax number (PIB), address and city, the order lines (product ID, SKU, name, quantity, price, amount paid), shipping and the customer note. When you send products (or save a product), it sends the product ID, SKU, name, variation, price and stock. With the stock check turned on, the cart lines (product ID, SKU, name, quantity) are sent before the order is placed. When you save the settings, the address of this site’s webhook endpoint is sent.
  • Receipt PDFs: when a receipt is issued, the plugin downloads its PDF from Solve.rs (/api/v1/orders/{id}/receipt/pdf) and stores it in wp-content/uploads/solve-rs-fiskalizacija, closed to direct access. The PDFs are removed when the order or the plugin is deleted.
  • What comes back: Solve.rs sends receipt numbers, verification links, refund and advance receipts, pro forma invoices and stock to /wp-json/solve-rs/v1/webhook on this site, signed with your webhook secret.
  • The fiscal receipts themselves are signed by the Tax Administration of Serbia (Poreska uprava) through Solve.rs; the verification links point to suf.purs.gov.rs.
  • Solve.rs terms of use: https://solve.rs/uslovi-koriscenja — privacy policy: https://invoice.solve.rs/privatnost
sections.installation:
You need a Solve.rs account with the Web shop module, WooCommerce 8.2 or newer and a site on https.

  1. Install and activate the plugin (Plugins → Add New → search for “Solve.rs Fiskalizacija”, or upload the zip file).
  2. In Solve.rs open Web shop → Shops → Connect a shop, choose “WooCommerce — Solve.rs plugin”, type a name (for example the site address — it is printed on the receipt) and connect. Copy the API key and the webhook secret — they are shown only once.
  3. In WordPress open WooCommerce → Solve.rs, paste both and click “Save and connect”. The webhook address is set in Solve.rs automatically. When the page says “Connected to the shop …”, you are done.
  4. In Solve.rs, on the shop card, choose when the receipt is issued (when the order is paid, shipped or completed — automatically or with one click).
  5. Optional: click “Send products to Solve.rs” and link the products with the warehouse in Solve.rs → Web shop → Products, then turn on stock there.
  6. Place a test order. After the receipt is issued, the order shows the receipt number and the verification link in the “Fiscal receipt (Solve.rs)” box.

Only orders made after connecting are sent, so older orders are not fiscalized twice. The “Help” tab on the plugin page has the same steps and troubleshooting.
sections.faq:
Do I need a fiscal device?

No. Solve.rs is an online cash register (ESIR with a virtual processor, V-PFR); receipts are signed online.

When is the receipt issued?

When the order reaches the status chosen in Solve.rs: when paid, when shipped or when completed. In manual mode you issue it with one click in Solve.rs.

What about cash on delivery?

WooCommerce marks cash on delivery orders as “Processing” right away, but nothing is paid yet. The plugin sends them as new orders, and the receipt is issued when the order is shipped or completed.

Can the customer check the receipt?

Yes. The link to the Tax Administration website is on the order page in My account and in the order emails.

Is the stock changed by the plugin?

Only if stock sync is turned on in Solve.rs. Then Solve.rs is the main stock and sends the available quantity (stock minus open orders) to the shop.

Where do I get the API key and the webhook secret?

In Solve.rs: Web shop → Shops → Connect a shop → “WooCommerce — Solve.rs plugin”. They are shown once; if you lose them, make new ones on the shop card (“New key” / “New secret”) and paste them in WooCommerce → Solve.rs again.

Receipt numbers do not come back to the order.

The site must use https, and a security plugin or firewall must allow requests to /wp-json/solve-rs/v1/webhook. Click “Check the connection” on the plugin page to set the webhook address in Solve.rs again.

My order says “Not delivered to Solve.rs”.

The plugin tries again after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes and up to 12 hours. You can also click “Send to Solve.rs again” on the order.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First version: orders to Solve.rs, receipts and refunds back to the order with their PDFs (send to the customer from the order), advance receipts, pro forma invoices, PIB field, stock and product list.
